New batch job
Parameters — pick one value to fix it, several to sweep

Every parameter defaults to each model's saved setting. Pick a single value to use it for the whole job; pick several and each becomes its own cell, multiplied against the models and presets above. All of these change how the engine is launched, so every combination is a separate load — 3 context lengths × 2 models is six loads, not six requests.

Context length (max_model_len) Use model's saved value
Maps to --max-model-len. The KV cache is pre-allocated at this size, so it is usually the parameter that decides whether a model fits.
Tensor parallel size (tensor_parallel_size) Use model's saved value
How many GPUs the model is split across. Must divide the model's attention head count.
GPU memory utilization (gpu_memory_utilization) Use model's saved value
Fraction of each card vLLM may use. Higher leaves more room for KV cache and less for everything else.
Max concurrent sequences (max_num_seqs) Use model's saved value
How many requests the engine will batch. Raising it trades latency for throughput.
KV cache dtype (kv_cache_dtype) Use model's saved value
FP8 halves the KV cache, which buys context length at some cost in quality.
Enforce eager mode (enforce_eager) Use model's saved value
Skips graph capture. Slower steady-state, faster startup — worth measuring rather than assuming.

Select models and presets to compute the matrix size.
